31700-E.s: The bill establishes the 2009 budget statement of the AOW savings fund (Spaarfonds AOW) in thousands of euros, with a total of 4,805,325 thousand euros under the fund's single line item. The explanatory memorandum notes that drawings from the fund after 2020 will raise government debt and that the fund's budget is presented on a cash basis.
31700-E.j: The memorandum justifies the fund's existence as a means to secure the long-term financeability of AOW pension spending amid population ageing.
q: The AOW savings fund was established in 1998 to secure the long-term financeability of AOW spending in the face of population ageing.
Het Spaarfonds AOW is in 1998 ingesteld om de financierbaarheid van de AOW-uitgaven op langere termijn door deze vergrijzing zeker te stellen.

32123-E.s: This bill adopts the 2010 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the AOW Savings Fund, setting amounts in thousands of euros and fixing the entry into force as 1 January 2010 with retroactive effect where publication is late. It is a purely budgetary act with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
32123-E.j: The memorandum justifies the fund's budget on the basis of article 86 of the Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen, which allows cash-basis presentation instead of the usual Comptabiliteitswet rules, and explains the fund's long-term purpose of securing AOW financing.
q: On the basis of article 86, sixth paragraph, of the Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen, the budget and financial accountability of the AOW Savings Fund are presented exclusively on a cash basis, deviating from articles 2(3) and 52(1) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.

Op basis van artikel 86, zesde lid van de Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen worden in afwijking van de artikelen 2, derde lid, en 52, eerste lid van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 de begroting en de financiële verantwoording van het Spaarfonds AOW uitsluitend op kasbasis gepresenteerd.

32222-E.s: The bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the AOW savings fund (Spaarfonds AOW) in connection with the autumn budget review (Najaarsnota), changing expenditure and receipts by the amounts listed in the attached statement. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 December 2009, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The budget statement of the AOW savings fund for 2009 is amended as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32360-B.s: This slotwet (final budget act) for the 2009 gemeentefonds (municipal fund) sets the definitive amounts for obligations, expenditures and receipts, and adjusts the budget. It fixes the verplichtingenbedragen for the general and targeted grants and reports realised spending against the budget.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for the 2009 grant year at € 15,734,865,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2009 vastgesteld op € 15 734 865 000.

32500-F.s: This bill fixes the 2011 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) at 9,100 thousand euros for disease control and animal welfare, in thousands of euros. It sets the entry into force as 1 January 2011, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad appears later.

32710-C.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement of the provincial fund by adjusting the commitment amounts for the general grant and the integration and decentralisation grants, and sets the rounding basis in thousands of euros. It also records the realised 2010 figures and the closing-law adjustments of roughly €1 million, with entry into force the day after publication and retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
32710-C.j: The memorandum explains the €199,000 difference by noting that the payments to municipalities can deviate from the budgeted amounts while the uitkeringsfactor is not yet final.
q: as long as the uitkeringsfactor 1 is not final, the amount of payments to municipalities may deviate from what is stated in the budget
zolang de uitkeringsfactor 1 niet definitief is de omvang van betalingen aan de gemeenten kan afwijken ten opzichte van wat in de begroting vermeld staat

33090-A.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructure Fund, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts per article following the autumn budget review (Najaarsnota). It sets amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 1 December 2011, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
33090-A.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by optimisation of execution, extra works and underspending on risk provisions, without delegating new powers.
q: This year no appeal is made to the risk reserve for the rail programme.
Dit jaar wordt geen beroep gedaan op de risicoreservering spoorprogramma.

33365-(R1987).s: The bill amends Article 53b of the Dutch Patent Act 1995 to introduce a limited breeding exemption, by removing the word 'exclusively' from the first paragraph and adding a second paragraph stating that the patent right does not extend to acts with biological material used to breed or develop new plant varieties. The law enters into force on a date set by royal decree.
33365-(R1987).j: The memorandum justifies the limited breeding exemption as necessary to make the EU directive's farmers' privilege workable, since without it the compulsory licence provision would be only theoretical.
q: Without a presupposed limited breeding exemption, invoking Article 12 of the directive is merely a theoretical possibility.
Zonder een vooronderstelde beperkte veredelingsvrijstelling is een beroep op artikel 12 van de richtlijn slechts een theoretische mogelijkheid.
d: fixing entry-into-force date by royal decree

parties: Asks whether 'nieuw' should be replaced by 'onderscheidbaar', whether the exemption should cover registration testing, and why Aruba is excluded, and requests the Commission's forthcoming report before plenary debate.
The members would like to hear from the government whether it is willing to replace the word 'nieuw' with 'onderscheidbaar', otherwise these members are considering an amendment on this point.
De leden horen graag van de regering of zij bereid is om het woord «nieuw» te vervangen door het woord «onderscheidbaar», anders overwegen deze leden een amendement op dit punt.
Questions whether the exemption truly helps breeders given remaining licence needs, the legal basis under TRIPS Article 27, and the risk of unknowingly using genetically modified material.
The members of the PvdA faction ask to what extent the limited breeder's exemption really helps breeders.
De leden van de fractie van de PvdA vragen in hoeverre de beperkte veredelingsvrijstelling veredelaars echt helpt.

Asks for an overview of countries where TRIPS has not blocked full breeder's exemptions, WTO proceedings, and the European Commission's reaction to French and German laws, pushing for a full exemption.
The members of the SP faction would like an assessment of India and other countries where the TRIPS Agreement apparently does not hinder plant breeders' rights and/or a full breeder's exemption.

De leden van de SP-fractie krijgen graag een beschouwing over India en andere landen in de wereld waar de TRIPS-Overeenkomst kennelijk geen belemmering vormt voor het verkrijgen van kwekersrecht en/of een volledige kwekersvrijstelling.

Questions whether the Biotechnology Directive implicitly allows a limited exemption, why the exemption is broader than the plant breeders' rights exemption, and the definition of 'biologisch materiaal', and whether the 'reasonable fee' for compulsory licences is set by whom.
Who determines what is reasonable, ask the members of the CDA faction?
Wie bepaalt wat redelijk is zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie?

Questions the government's claim that only a limited exemption is possible, citing an academic who concludes TRIPS does not preclude a full breeder's exemption, and asks how the exemption relates to Article 50 of the Seed and Planting Material Act.
The members speaking constate, however, that this does not necessarily have to be the case.
De aan het woord zijnde leden constateren echter dat dit niet noodzakelijkerwijs het geval hoeft te zijn.

Welcomes the limited exemption as a first step but urges a broader exemption, asks whether the government will seek clarity from an international panel on TRIPS, and whether compulsory licensing is a serious alternative.

Is the government willing to seek clarity on this point by submitting to an international panel the question of whether the TRIPS Agreement allows for a full breeder's exemption in the plant breeding sector?

Is de regering bereid om op dit punt duidelijkheid te vragen door de vraag of de TRIPS-Overeenkomst ruimte biedt voor een volledige veredelingsvrijstelling in de plantenveredelingssector, voor te leggen aan een internationaal panel?
Supports the bill but argues the Raad van State and ministry analyses ignore TRIPS Article 27(3)(b) and asks the government to reconsider, including with advice from the Raad van State.
The members ask the government to address the aforementioned analysis based on Article 27(3) of the TRIPS Agreement, whether or not after obtaining advice from, for example, the Council of State.
De leden vragen de regering in te gaan op de genoemde analyse op basis van artikel 27, lid 3, van de TRIPS-Overeenkomst, al dan niet na ingewonnen advies van bijvoorbeeld de Raad van State.

Supports the limited exemption as a first step but argues a broad exemption is legally possible under TRIPS and that patenting of plants and animals should be banned, questioning the government's reliance on the Council of State's view.
Contrary to what the Council of State has ruled, several jurists point out that the broad breeder's exemption is indeed possible under the TRIPS Agreement.
In tegenstelling tot wat de Raad van State heeft geoordeeld, wijzen meerdere juristen erop dat de uitgebreide veredelingsvrijstelling wél mogelijk is onder het TRIPS-verdrag.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on a bill introducing a limited breeders' exemption in the Dutch patent act, finding it possibly inconsistent with TRIPS Article 30 and the Biotechnology Directive and asking for justification and possible adaptation. The government's reply (nader rapport) rebuts most points, arguing the exemption fits TRIPS and the Directive, adds clarifications, and makes some textual amendments.
concerns: The Afdeling doubted that the limited breeders' exemption qualifies as a limited exception under TRIPS Article 30 and asked for supplementation; the government added reasoning in the memorie van toelichting but maintained compatibility.

The Afdeling argued the exemption cannot be presupposed from Biotechnology Directive Article 12 and that the Directive's exhaustive harmonisation stands in the way; the government defended its reading and added explanation.

The Afdeling questioned whether the Directive's experimental-use exception in Article 13 can cover breeding and asked to reconsider in light of Regulation 2100/94; the government accepted that experimental use does not include breeding and removed that justification.

The Afdeling advised clarifying the scope of the exemption regarding material covered by Article 53a(3) and aligning its wording with Regulation 2100/94; the government clarified scope and amended wording.
Redactional remarks on the wording of the bill were adopted in the amended text.

33400-F.s: The bill formally adopts the 2013 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) at EUR 9.7 million in expenditure and receipts. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 January 2013, with retroactive effect where publication occurs later.
q: Article 1: The budget statement of the Animal Health Fund for the year 2013 attached to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Diergezondheidsfonds voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

34000-I.s: This bill sets the 2015 budget of the Crown (the King's household and functional expenditure) at about 40 million euros, with no revenue lines. It fixes the appropriation in thousands of euros and sets entry into force on 1 January 2015.
q: The budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2015 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34000-XVIII.s: The bill fixes the 2015 budget statements for the Ministry of Interior Affairs and Kingdom Relations' housing and civil service portfolio (Wonen en Rijksdienst), including expenditure, revenue and cash-flow tables for agencies. It enacts budget amounts only and does not itself delegate rule-making power.
q: Article 1: The budget statement attached to this act for the year 2015 is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34350-A.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for 2015 through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditure and revenue across road, rail, regional, waterway and mega-project articles. It is a purely budgetary adjustment with no new delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2015 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34589-(R2077).s: The bill is a Rijkswet approving the Paris Climate Agreement of 12 December 2015 for the entire Kingdom, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution before the Kingdom can be bound. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: the Paris Agreement requires approval by the States General under Article 91(1) of the Constitution before the Kingdom can be bound by it
Overeenkomst van Parijs ingevolge artikel 91, eerste lid, van de Grondwet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal behoeft, alvorens het Koninkrijk daaraan kan worden gebonden

parties: Asks whether the Paris commitments and NDCs are legally binding and whether future changes will be submitted to parliament for approval, and questions the adequacy of the short debate timetable.
The Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) are included in the decision accompanying the Agreement and are therefore not legally binding, the VVD members believe.
De Nationally Determined Contributions (NDC's) zijn opgenomen in het besluit bij de Overeenkomst en zijn daarmee niet juridisch bindend, zo menen de leden van de VVD-fractie.
Asks for an exact emission target for the Netherlands and the EU and for a binding climate law with oversight through five-year plans and annual climate budgets.
The PvdA members request that the government state an exact (treaty-derived) emission target for the Netherlands and the EU, as the Council of State also asked.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie verzoeken de regering een exacte (uit het verdrag voortvloeiende) emissiedoelstelling voor Nederland en de EU aan te geven, zoals ook de Raad van State heeft gevraagd.
Asks for an assessment of measures and financial consequences, reflection on the legal obligations before the national court, and timelines for implementing rules.
The CDA members ask the government to reflect on the legal obligation under the Paris Agreement before the national court.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering te reflecteren op de juridische verplichting van de op 12 december 2015 tot stand gekomen overeenkomst van Parijs voor de nationale rechter.
Worried that emissions will not fall sharply between 2020 and 2030 and asks when the Energy Agenda will be sent to parliament so it can be debated in time.
These members ask when the Energy Agenda 2016 will be sent to the House and whether this will be well before the Christmas recess, so there is enough time to debate it before the Christmas recess.

Deze leden vragen wanneer de Energieagenda 2016 naar de Kamer komt en of dit ruimschoots voor het kersreces zal zijn, opdat er voldoende tijd overblijft om hierover vóór het kerstreces in de Kamer te debatteren.
Argues the EU's 40% target for 2030 is too weak and asks the government to push for more ambitious targets and a stronger Dutch NDC.
Given the need to quickly reduce greenhouse gas emissions, the EU's INDC for 2030 with a 40% reduction ambition is simply too little.
Gezien de noodzaak om snel de uitstoot van broeikasgassen terug te brengen is de INDC van de EU voor 2030 met een ambitie van een vermindering van 40% simpelweg te weinig.
Asks for a broad climate law and an institution or commissioner to oversee implementation, and asks how the agreed biennial reporting will involve the House.
Following on from this, the aforementioned members believe that to shape the major transition we face with appropriate urgency and coherent policy, a broad climate law is necessary.
Hierop aansluitend zijn bovengenoemde leden van mening dat om de grote transitie waar we voor staan met gepaste urgentie en coherent beleid vorm te geven een brede klimaatwet noodzakelijk is.
Asks for detailed figures on global poverty, population growth, spending on climate and water safety, and whether job relocation to developing countries will occur.
The PVV members have received the present bill with dissatisfaction.
De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben met onvrede kennisgenomen van het voorliggend wetsvoorstel.
Hopes for swift ratification and looks forward to the Dutch implementation.
The SP members hope for swift ratification of the agreement and look forward with interest to its Dutch implementation.
De leden van de SP-fractie hopen op een snelle ratificatie van het akkoord en kijken met belangstelling uit naar de Nederlandse invulling ervan.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised submitting the Paris Agreement approval bill to the parliaments, but asked the explanatory memorandum to address the exceptional scale of the policy and financial obligations the treaty imposes on the Netherlands. The government's reply reports that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented with a passage at the end of paragraph 3 and that the bill was adjusted accordingly.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should address the exceptional scale of the policy and financial implementation obligations the Paris Agreement entails for the Netherlands, which the government did by adding a passage.

34620-A.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructure Fund, shifting commitment and expenditure amounts among infrastructure articles such as the main road network, railways and mega-projects. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date of 1 December 2016, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2016 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

35350-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2019 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (second supplementary budget), adjusting commitment and expenditure figures across policy articles. It does not delegate rule-making power or alter oversight arrangements, and no explanatory memorandum was found.
q: We have deemed it appropriate and resolved ... The departmental budget statement ... for the year 2019 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat ... voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd

35859-(R2157).s: The bill adds a new option right to the Dutch Nationality Act allowing persons who lost Dutch nationality by operation of law, together with EU citizenship, to recover it with retroactive effect after a proportionality review under EU law. It also extends the residence-related loss period from ten to thirteen years and adds coordinating amendments tied to a pending bill on statelessness.
35859-(R2157).j: The memorandum justifies the new option right by the need to apply the EU proportionality principle to persons who lost nationality and EU citizenship, as required by EU case law.
q: The authority receiving the option declaration carries out a review against the proportionality principle recognised by EU law.
De autoriteit die de optieverklaring in ontvangst neemt verricht een toetsing aan het door het Unierecht erkende evenredigheidsbeginsel.
d: autoriteit must request ministerial advice on option declarations
p: Creates a proportionality-based option right that gives affected persons a route to regain nationality retroactively, expanding citizens' protection against loss of nationality, while administrative authorities assess each case.

parties: Asks how many people lost nationality under the cited articles and how many may claim reconsideration, and how costs are covered.
These members ask for how many persons Dutch nationality has been lost since 1993 under the cited articles of the Nationality Act.

Deze leden vragen voor hoeveel personen het Nederlanderschap verloren is gegaan op grond van artikel 14, zesde lid, artikel 15, eerste lid, aanhef en onder a en c, of artikel 16, eerste lid, onder a, c of d van de RWN, sinds 1993.
Questions the government's narrow scope limiting proportionality review to EU-law consequences, despite the Council of State's concerns about disproportionate effects on family and working life.
The D66 members doubt that in the situation mentioned by the Council of State disproportionate consequences would not readily arise.
De leden van de D66-fractie betwijfelen of in de door de Afdeling genoemde situatie niet snel sprake zal zijn van onevenredige gevolgen.
Asks how the proportionality test works, which non-exhaustive criteria apply, and whether old cases and expatriates can reopen claims.
These members ask the government to explain how the proportionality review takes place and on which non-exhaustive criteria.
Deze leden vragen de regering of kan worden toegelicht op welke wijze de evenredigheidstoets plaatsvindt en aan de hand van welke niet-limitatieve criteria.

Considers the bill a missed opportunity to protect people from losing nationality without a conscious choice, and asks why review is limited to cases with EU citizenship loss and why criteria are left to a manual.
they nonetheless consider the present bill a missed opportunity to prevent Dutch nationals who do not consciously choose it from losing their nationality.
achten zij het nu voorliggende wetsvoorstel toch een gemiste kans om te voorkomen dat Nederlanders die daarvoor niet bewust kiezen hun Nederlanderschap verliezen.
Opposes automatic loss of nationality, asks for clear criteria to avoid legal uncertainty, and raises effects on children and on rights during the gap period.
These members ask the government to argue why, in its view, this does not lead to (undesirable) legal uncertainty and/or legal inequality.
Deze leden vragen de regering te beargumenteren waarom dit in haar ogen niet tot (ongewenste) rechtsonzekerheid en/of rechtsongelijkheid leidt.
Asks whether the Court of Justice ruling was foreseeable, whether other member states must amend laws, and how narrowly the ruling is being interpreted.
These members ask the government whether implementation of this ruling is being interpreted as narrowly as possible.
Deze leden vragen de regering of de uitvoering van dit arrest op deze manier zo eng mogelijk geïnterpreteerd is.

Objects that proportionality review happens only after nationality is withdrawn and that the burden of initiative lies with citizens; asks why the government places the burden on individuals and whether IND and courts are equipped.
Would it not then be better to place the burden of proof on the government, since there is no equality of arms and the government is the stronger party?
Zou het dan ook niet beter zijn de bewijslast bij de overheid te leggen, aangezien er geen sprake is van «equality of arms» en de overheid de sterkere partij is?
Welcomes the extended period and retroactive effect but asks why review occurs only after loss, why it is limited to EU-law cases, and how affected persons will be informed.
Why does the government choose not to carry out the proportionality review at the moment of loss, asks the BIJ1 member.
Waarom kiest de regering ervoor de evenredigheidstoets niet op het moment van verlies te doen, zo vraagt het lid van de fractie van Bij1.
Asks why proportionality review is limited to EU-law consequences, whether consular protection was considered, and whether IND has a work instruction.
Why is the proportionality review limited to EU-law consequences?
Waarom wordt de evenredigheidstoets beperkt tot Unie-rechterlijke gevolgen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, on a bill amending the Dutch Nationality Act to allow proportionality review after loss of nationality by operation of law, that the bill's scope is too narrow because it only covers cases where Union citizenship is also lost, and that the explanation should be revised. The government's reply argues the bill only implements the CJEU judgment, that the Court requires nothing further, and that disproportionate consequences are unlikely in the situation the Afdeling raised, so no change is made.
concerns: The Afdeling argues that loss of nationality without loss of Union citizenship may also have disproportionate effects on family and professional life, so limiting proportionality review is unjustified.

35975-XIII.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) and the budget for its agencies through a second supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations and spending across policy articles. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2021.
35975-XIII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by lower-than-expected uptake of COVID-19 support schemes and an improved economic situation, without any delegation of new powers.
q: The cash budget for the TVL is lowered by € 2.718 billion for 2021 due to lower uptake of the scheme than estimated.
Het kasbudget voor de TVL wordt voor 2021 met € 2,718 mld verlaagd in verband met een lager beroep op de regeling dan geraamd.

36250-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts by policy article in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date to one day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2022.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation for the year 2022
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenweking voor het jaar 2022

36410-B.s: This bill fixes the 2024 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) at 42.87 billion euros and sets the commitment amounts for the general grant and the integration and decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It enters into force on 1 January 2024 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for grant year 2024 at € 38,393,830,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2024 vastgesteld op € 38.393.830.000.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering has no remarks on the draft Gemeentefonds budget bill (begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds) for 2024 and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The accompanying nader rapport from the Minister of Finance, on behalf of the Minister of Interior Affairs, forwards the advice without any substantive points requiring response.

36600-A.s: The bill establishes the 2025 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Mobiliteitsfonds, setting expenditure, commitments and receipts in thousands of euros for infrastructure and waterways. It takes effect on 1 January of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Article 1: The budget statement of the Mobility Fund belonging to this act, referred to in article 2 of the Mobility Fund Act, is established for the year 2025.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Mobiliteitsfonds, genoemd in artikel 2 van de Wet Mobiliteitsfonds, voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.
